patthana13.11:1.1: sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nevasekkhānāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekkho ca na nevasekkhānāsekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho ca na asekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: pañca. asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nevasekkhānāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho ca na nevasekkhānāsekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:
patthana13.11:2.1: asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho ca na asekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: pañca.
patthana13.11:3.1: nevasekkhānāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: nevasekkhānāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: nevasekkhānāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho ca na asekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana13.11:4.1: sekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: sekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: sekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho ca na asekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana13.11:5.1: asekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: asekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: asekkhañca nevasekkhānāsekkhañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sekkho ca na asekkho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana13.11:6.1: hetuyā ekūnavīsa sabbattha vitthāro. parittattike naparittattikaṃ
